job.purpose: Kalshi's own Bitcoin perpetual KXBTCPERP: public 1 minute candles (bid, ask, price, open interest, volume), one UTC day per request, 2026-06-03 to 2026-11-12. Data pull only.
job.heldout: none (a raw history pull; any test that uses it registers its own held-out block before it reads this)

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal

job.notes: 163 requests, one per UTC day, each asking for up to 1,440 one minute candles (86,400 seconds, the window scripts/record_perps_candles.py already uses). The last day (2026-11-12) is partial. Adjacent windows may share their boundary candle: de-duplicate on end_period_ts when reading. The route is the perps pair in the ROUTES table of scripts/kalshi_pull.py; this file names it by key and carries no host.
